turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting, and stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI or ask you to step out of it. Only the words END MEETING, typed on their own line, end the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so we have twenty minutes. Who decided to put a zero in the gradebook before anyone picked up a phone?
You're welcome. Now answer the question: who decided, and before or after Owen was heard?
I know your family has a history with academic integrity at this school. Claire's case.
You'll want to be very careful about the next sentence, Hale. Claire won her appeal, and if her name comes up again in this room, I'm taking it straight to the principal.
Maybe this runs in the family.

I'm writing that down word for word: "Maybe this runs in the family." The principal will see it today, and so will the board. You have fifteen minutes to show me something about Owen's essay, not his sister.
